name.en: Breath of the Tiger! Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister Storms In!
name.ja: 闘いの虎吸！上城大華登場！

notes: The following rewards were awarded during this event, based on event points accumulated over the course of the event:

rows.text: Card Sleeves: Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister & Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend
Game Mat: Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister & Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend
Title: Breath of the Tiger!  Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister Complete
Card Sleeves: Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister & Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend
Game Mat: Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister & Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend
Title: Breath of the Tiger!  Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister Complete

notes: When Dueling against Tiadosia "Tiger" Kallister at Level 40 or higher, these are the only cards that can drop; at lower levels, cards from the standard pool for Legendary Duelists may also drop.
Event Duelists possess the same rewards, but since they only spawn at Level 30, cards from the standard pool may also drop.

rows.text: "Full Orchestra the Music Fiend", "Axtion Melody the Music Princess"
"Ensembullfighter the Music Fiend", "Tubardiche the Music Princess"

notes: The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remains open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, Gold, and Skill Chips. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
These missions were available from the start of the event.
